messages:
kai: quick design check: proposing a "fast-fail" mini-admit harness that runs in ~120s as the very first gate. it should detect catastrophic issues (tokenizer/formatting/kv-corruption) and emit a compact verdict + repro command.

nina: love the fast-fail idea. what exactly counts as catastrophic? we should enumerate strict heuristics.

drew: catastrophic = any tokenization mismatch that changes offsets, kv roundtrip != exact, or generation that immediately outputs invalid control tokens. also large top1 divergence (>20%) on anchor short-case.

kai: agreed. harness flow: 1) fetch model artifact 2) run tokenizer parity (seeded) 3) run kv roundtrip smoke 4) tiny gen (1 token) on short anchor. stop on first hard fail.

ryan: operational constraints: make the harness container tiny and hermetic. we should pin numpy/pytorch versions and expose "harness-env" in logs. ops-bot: please bake image.

ops-bot: infra:fast-fail-image:v0.1 created. digest sha256:abc123. scheduled for canary push.

nina: outputs: decision enum (FAST_PASS | FAST_FAIL | NEEDS_DEEP), reasons[], repro_cmd, artifacts: [mini-report-url]. keep payload <2k chars so gateway can inline it.

drew: for reproducibility include exact tokenizer hash and the single-seed used. repro_cmd example: `./fast-fail --artifact 0xabc --case short --seed 7`.

kai: how to tie into existing mini-bench? idea: fast-fail runs synchronously at intake; if PASS, then enqueue the longer mini-bench (3-6m) async. if FAIL -> quarantine. NEEDS_DEEP -> schedule full bench.

ryan: telemetry: log runner_cpu_ms, gpu_type (if used), container_digest, and elapsed_ms. also emit short diff of tokenizer tokens if mismatch.

nina: security note: private deployments must be able to run the same harness offline. add a signed attest field for offline-run results so admissions audit can verify.

drew: edge-case: float nondeterminism can make top1 noisy for tiny models. add a deterministic-mode flag that forces fixed seeds and disables jitter ops.

kai: UX ask: console should surface the repro_cmd as a single-click action that spins up a local debug container. small sidenote: add a "suppressible" tag for legacy models so we don't auto-quarantine them.

ryan: I'll open infra PR to add endpoint /fast-fail-check and update admit-gateway routing. SLA target: sync fast-fail <= 2.5m 99th.

nina: thanks. can someone volunteer to draft the harness README and the list of hard-fail heuristics? I'll own the API contract.

drew: I'll draft heuristics doc and include example diffs.

kai: perfect. tagging @ryan for infra rollout and @nina for API. i'll file the mini epic and link everything. :white_check_mark:
